walkthrough: Goal: V大's 抽象对比分析 (weeks 5 and 6): a good picture looked at with its content forgotten for a while, only its shapes and colours: what draws my eye most, by what contrast it draws it (lightness, hard against soft edges, purity, hue, size, isolation), what is second and what is weak, and how strength is spread over the picture (even, linear, one far above the rest, one above a weaker rhythm). Nothing is scored: Compare shows where each contrast lives in the picture, and my eye judges my own analysis against it.

Entry: the composition pack imported (Import practice pack… in the practice options, the picker answered with the test compositions); a lesson of Abstract analysis at level 1 from the home holds one composition of the simple tier. Unit 5, after key shifts.

How, first time: Analyse a picture; a picture seen as shapes and colours only. The example, the landscape the divisions share, lies in one frame of its shape: the house ringed red with Strong (1), the tree ringed green with Second and a few blue strokes hatched in the calm sky with Weak (2), Compare: the picture faint, the marks over it (3). One paragraph says what to choose on the card before Compare, nothing of what Compare draws or who judges (S146).

Got it. The picture lies in one frame of its shape on the sheet itself, on a layer of its own under my marks (Picture, 原图, locked): no second frame beside it; the frame as large as its place on the sheet holds it, in the middle of the room left of the card, the lesson's title above it (S158k). The tools: Strong (red), Second (green), Weak (blue), Undo, Redo; no Sketch, no Draw, no eyedropper. The card under them: Abstract analysis 1, then V大's four steps: 1 What draws you most (ring it with Strong); 2 By what contrast, six chips; 3 The second and the weak (ring with Second, hatch with Weak); 4 How strength is spread, four small pictures of bars.

I ring the house with Strong in a quick ring of few samples, drawn smooth, the tree with Second, hatch the empty sky with Weak; Undo takes the last stroke back, Redo returns it; the picture under them never moves. On the card I turn Lightness on, Hue on and off again, and choose Noisy: Lightness and Noisy carry the ink pill.

Compare: the card is its title, Which contrast with five views (Lightness, Chroma, Hue, Edges, Squint), then what I chose in the chips' words (You chose: Lightness; Spread: Noisy), then Accurate, Almost and Again. Lightness first: the picture veiled in paper where its lightness contrast is weak, clear in bands along the strong edges (the house, the tree, the hill's ridge), my marks over the veil in their colours, the Strong ring as smooth as I drew it (S158k). Chroma: clear round the light house and its red roof and along the green field's edge, the soft hill and sky veiled; Hue: clear where the green meets the grey and the blue; Edges: here much as Lightness, every edge of the test picture being hard; Squint: the picture blurred as a squinting eye sees it, my marks over it.
I choose Almost. My choices are kept with the first Compare and fixed from then on; a mark drawn after Compare takes the comparison away, as on every sheet.

Finish: the lesson's end, Abstract analysis, 1 exercise. One more: a second analysis on the next row of the same sheet, another picture laid under its frame on the same Picture layer, the first left as it was.
Reopen: Home leaves it under way; Continue on the home reopens it, the pictures laid under both frames, nothing laid twice.
Level 3 (稳): a hard composition, or the nearest tier the pack holds (the test pack has none: a medium one).
Chinese: s112-abstract-analysis-zh runs this walk-through on a Chinese tablet: 抽象分析, the pens 强, 次, 弱, the chips 明度, 虚实, 纯度, 色相, 大小, 隔离, the pictures 平均, 线性, 曲线, 带噪声, the views and 眯眼.
Not here: the author's eye on the tablet; the veils judged on the 61 official compositions (the harness's contrasts contact sheets, S112a).
